notes: Configuration reference; not a request body for a particular Runpod API version.
Leave Container Start Command empty to inherit the official /start.sh.
For data that survives Pod termination, attach a Network Volume mounted at /workspace.
The image contains software and workflows. Model weights download to the volume on first start.
Fill HF_TOKEN only in the Runpod environment before starting the Pod; never put a real token in this file.
Set JUPYTER_PASSWORD and PUBLIC_KEY only when those access methods are needed.
